# On Island Hosting

> A boutique Airbnb co-host for luxury vacation homes in Kailua-Kona, Hawaii, run by Airbnb Superhost Linda Montoya.

Homeowners keep their listings, guest reviews and online reputation on Airbnb while Linda provides dedicated on-island support. On Island Hosting partners with a select number of homeowners.

## What a co-host does here

- Revenue and occupancy strategy: dynamic pricing, listing optimization and seasonal rate planning
- Guest experience: thoughtful communication, five-star hospitality standards and curated local touches
- Property presentation: staging guidance, photo-readiness and amenity planning
- On-island oversight: vendor coordination, inspections and quality checks before and after every guest stay

## About Linda Montoya

Linda is an Airbnb Superhost, a Kona resident and an HOA board member, with 20 years in digital advertising for brands such as Paramount Pictures, Target and Toyota.

## Blog

- [Airbnb Co-Host vs. Property Manager: What's the Difference?](https://onislandhosting.com/blog/airbnb-co-host-vs-property-manager-kona/): listing ownership, how rental income is paid, guest experience, pricing and on-island care for Kona vacation rental owners.
